title: Prison
content: Has anyone else had a prison in their mall world? It’s been pretty recent for me, but ive been recently getting arrested and thrown into a prison usually for silly things like evading an officer or for some misunderstanding. I have been spending a lot of time in and out of there recently and wondered if anyone had the same experience? It almost feels like I’m getting to lucid or crazy in my dream world and I being punished for it.
